title: 刘俊贝：中国消费信心待修复，AI与科技机会真实
speaker: Junbelio

segments.en: Australia is a little bit hidden as we talked to. It's not direct AI. We don't have the sexy likes. We are the picks and shovels, they call it, and then the raw material. So we are actually already seeing that thematic emerging in the Australian market, they're much cheaper. These companies are generating good cash flow, good dividend. And then they now have their pipeline suddenly just picked up enormously.
segments.zh: 澳大利亚有点隐蔽，不是直接AI，而是卖铲子的角色。这些公司更便宜，现金流和股息好，现在项目管道突然大增。

segments.en: And what's also interesting is your Australian market in terms of data-centred investment. There's a couple of years behind what's happening in the US. So we are seeing what has been going so well in the US now playing out in the Australian market. We're a little bit of lag. And as far as China's concern, the earning story seems to be the number one concern. Or the lack of an earning story seems to be the number one concern. Do you share that view? Or are you looking at something else?
segments.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心投资比美国落后几年，正在复制美国的故事。至于内地市场，盈利故事似乎是首要担忧，您同意吗？

segments.en: Yeah, look, I think with the, in the consumer front, certainly, and corporates. So it's actually, what would they call it, the KShB economy, isn't it? So we've got the one one part, the investment across the AI and others are doing incredibly well. Whereas in the consumer front to the consumption, it's still pretty poor. I think the confidence we are at least seeing the property market, still doing pretty badly, but it is stabilizing.
segments.zh: 在消费端和企业端，确实存在K形分化。AI等投资领域表现很好，但消费仍然疲弱。房地产市场虽然仍差，但正在企稳。

segments.en: So it's the confidence we need to see real income coming through. And perhaps we'll still a few quarters away. But ultimately, with the consumer not really investing in the housing market and the like, I think it's a massive tailwind into the share market and given where some of those government protected and directed space, the opportunities are the technology, the AI, and I think the opportunities are real there.
segments.zh: 信心需要实际收入增长来修复，可能还需几个季度。但消费者不买房，反而成为权益市场的巨大顺风。在政府支持和引导的领域，科技和AI的机会是真实的。
